manifest.scope: Private release-artifact comparison using the public optional memory-cycle CLI; all local/remote and wrap configurations in this matrix. Every transition waits for complete persisted source, syntax and current geometry. Collection mode is explicit in memoryCohort; retention timings are excluded and its peak is not the natural no-collection peak. Five-cycle smoke does not establish sustained-memory behavior. Production single-input fields retain their original observation; memoryCycles and memoryAfterCycles describe the repeated-edit cohort.

frozenCandidate.scope: Viewport candidate; consult the separate verification receipt for complete-source CI status. Complete-row HTML reuse preserves CSS-only wrapping, bounded fragments require current source/syntax/glyph ownership, and warm wrapped preparations coalesce through a task. Original recovery transport. Native device and new hosted checks remain pending.

memoryCycles.scope: Native one-character beginning edits and Control-Z. Full persisted source must alternate before each next action. No clipboard, changed readiness deadlines or synthetic source publication. Checkpoints follow confirmed autosave and syntax/layout readiness. Peak sampling spans cold startup, original input and all cycles. Explicit collection covers all owned page/worker/service-worker heaps at checkpoints; complete persisted source, syntax and layout are rechecked afterward. These timings are excluded from latency acceptance; use the separate no-collection cohort for natural resident-memory peak.

peakMeasurementScope: Periodic collection study; uninterrupted natural peak comes from the separate normal cohort
